title: GPT-4chan: This is the worst AI ever
summary: Yannic Kilcher explains how he trained a language model on three years of 4chan's /pol/ board and let it post on the site. He evaluates how good the model was and discusses the ethics and fallout.
why: HN points to it as the definitive account of the GPT-4chan experiment, used in debates on LLM bias, truthfulness and bots.

quote.text: might be the coolest thing an LLM has ever done on video
